name: Sunhome
description: Boros Legion fortress and spiritual hub.

description_citations.text: "Precinct Four". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Razia declares justice requires the suffering of the guilty.
timeline.quote: Justice is toothless without punishment.

citation.text: Cleansing Beam (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Razia says the pyres of unbelievers should light the way.
timeline.quote: Let the pyres of the unbelievers light our way.

citation.text: Brightflame (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Razia credits the Boros with turning a wild goblin into a focused soldier.
timeline.quote: The Boros have given him the skill of a soldier and focused his heart with a single cause.

citation.text: Boros Recruit (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Krenko surveys Sunhome from a rooftop and notes many dead soldiers loaded onto a Golgari corpse-hauler.
timeline.quote: Krenko began his surveillance on Sunhome, the imposing Boros guildhall.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
timeline.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A fistfight breaks out among the soldiers, and Krenko enjoys the tension.
timeline.quote: Such undisciplined hot-headedness seemed very un-Boros.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A goblin worker tells Krenko that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master, who will be banished.
timeline.quote: Aurelia's gonna be our new master, 'cause she says that no disgraced angel's got the right to rule.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko sets fires and bombs through the floors of Sunhome to create chaos and slips unnoticed into Vinrenn's chambers.
timeline.quote: Chaos is the best cover, and Krenko went about setting fires and kicking down doors.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko finds an angel in stasis inside a detention sphere and smashes it open with the shiv's handle.
timeline.quote: With another good smash, the sphere dissipated, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko plucks two feathers from the angel and falsely screams that she attacked him, and guards seize her.
timeline.quote: "She tried to escape! She's free. She attacked me!"

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: As Krenko leaves, a large explosion rocks Sunhome.
timeline.quote: a large explosion rocked Sunhome.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Gorev remembers the old Boros under Razia and the angels of Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Gorev was one of them, beholding his angelic commander, bathing in her fierce, sublime gaze.

citation.text: "The Absolution of the Guildpact". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon is escorted into the Boros war room and feels Aurelia's overwhelming angelic aura.
timeline.quote: her aura was an order of magnitude higher than any he had encountered

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia says she has heard Gideon saved a Boros brigade from a Rakdos ambush.
timeline.quote: I have word that you saved an entire brigade of my Boros from a Rakdos ambush that would have killed every last one of them.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia reveals the Boros were once led by a disgrace to the Legion, which forced a change in guild leadership.
timeline.quote: We were led by a disgrace to the Legion.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia takes Gideon to a balcony overlooking Boros armies training and says she wishes to cleanse the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Ninth is a stain on Ravnica, a stain on the Boros, and a stain on my soul.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia offers Gideon command of a battalion, whether or not he joins the Boros.
timeline.quote: I am prepared to give you command of that battalion, there, if you will fight with us.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon accepts, resolving to wield Boros weapons for the greater good without becoming Boros, and asks when they start.
timeline.quote: He was not ready to become Boros.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia tells Gideon he is always welcome at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: You are always welcome at Sunhome, Jura.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Krenko surveils Sunhome, pushes it into violence and uses the chaos to reach Vinrenn's chambers.
timeline.quote: He provided that push and used the ensuing chaos to cover his actions

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko breaks the detention sphere holding an angel, plucks two feathers and falsely blames her escape before fleeing.
timeline.quote: He broke the sphere, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sergeant Skormak promotes Ossett to Wojek, giving her a red cord and a sealed letter.
timeline.quote: My first accolade.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Ossett realizes her invitation to a reception is a coded briefing for her first counterintelligence assignment and decodes a meeting at a bunker near the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: This isn't an invitation. It's the briefing for my first assignment as a Wojek counterintelligence agent.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Aresaan snoops over Ossett's shoulder and mocks her promotion.
timeline.quote: It's a fine accomplishment for someone with such weak convictions.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Ossett bribes Skormak's assistant to slip a release form into his signature pile, then discovers the prisoner is related to the raider Govan Radley.
timeline.quote: Baas Solvar isn't her full name. Baas Solvar Radley.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Aresaan taunts Ossett while she works and Ossett decides to ignore the truth about the prisoner.
timeline.quote: I just need to go on ignoring the truth.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Aresaan intercepts Ossett outside Sunhome and goes in with her to report the murder.
timeline.quote: I know we haven't been the most cordial of co-workers, but I'll come with you if you want

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Guards arrest Ossett for the poisonings of Skormak, Sidian and Atalay and find the poison-filled angel piece in her coin purse.
timeline.quote: You're suspected in the acute poisonings of Sergeant Embrel Skormak, Second Lieutenant Devin Sidian, and Guildmage Rook Atalay.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Ossett deduces that Skormak, the only survivor, poisoned himself to gain a promotion and that the minotaur guard killed Brazer, and exposes the dust on her uniform.
timeline.quote: Skormak is behind this and he poisoned himself to escape the blame.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Aresaan's fire exposes the dragon-bone Rubblebelt dust on the minotaur, who throws down the poison and flees.
timeline.quote: When we regain our composure, the spy is gone.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Aresaan unbinds her wings and carries Ossett to Skormak's desk at Annex Four.
timeline.quote: Razor wire crumbles as she flexes her wings against it

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Skormak admits his motive, resentment that flame-kin are denied high rank, and accuses the Legion of injustice.
timeline.quote: Three out of thousands . Just because we were cast instead of born doesn't mean we aren't capable of performing in high ranks.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Ossett rams Skormak into a wall and Aresaan douses him with a water elemental, extinguishing him into wet ashes.
timeline.quote: He smolders like a pinched wick, then dissipates into a pile of wet ashes and charred armor.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.
